resource_observation.limits: Current observations after the reported kill; inspector RLIMITs are not a measured peak for the failed process. No matched before/after OOM counter was supplied.

memory_interpretation.meaning: 6.31 GiB was MemAvailable, not memory used. Observation was after the failure; it is not the failed process peak and does not rule out an earlier or narrower-limit OOM.

memory_risk_reasoning.established_runtime_behavior: Removing LEAN_NUM_THREADS gives Lake the ordinary hardware-based pool default. Lean compiler CLI children independently already default to detected hardware concurrency unless -j overrides it. Task waits can expand runtime worker allowance.
memory_risk_reasoning.inference: More simultaneous compiler jobs can increase aggregate private heaps and active working sets. Some file-backed import pages can be shared, so aggregate memory cannot be calculated as process count times one RSS sample.
memory_risk_reasoning.limits: No process-count or peak-memory sample at the failure was captured. The observed exit137 does not establish an OOM kill or prove increased concurrency caused this failure.

conditional_next_step.proposal: At most one unchanged uncapped incremental retry after the actual overall terminal result, if only exit137 failures remain and substantial valid outputs completed.
conditional_next_step.rationale: The unchanged integrity guard may reuse successful outputs, leaving fewer independent modules requiring simultaneous compilation; this can reduce aggregate memory demand without imposing a numeric cap.
preconditions: Original command actually terminal and evidence retained
Same frozen candidate and exact inputs
No unresolved integrity mismatch, proof error or different failure requiring its own handling
Retain original unrestricted launch and full checker/audit
caveats: Runtime concurrency remains unrestricted; lower memory demand is not guaranteed
Failed prerequisites may release a large downstream dependency set in the retry
A repeated137 or lost execution state leaves receiving validation pending; no environment repair campaign follows automatically
